description: Nomid staff only (Nomid system admins; refused for everyone else). Lists one company's portal AI chat conversations, reviewed or not, most recently active first (default: the last 7 days), each with its sessionId, title and dates. Use company to name the company; another customer's needs an "All Nomid customers" connection. Pass a sessionId to read that conversation (a long one comes in parts: pass nextFromTurn as fromTurn): every turn's text, the tools the agent called with their status and input summary, proposals with their live outcome, and the user's feedback. Text is redacted (emails, company names, secrets) and the user is not identified; tool results are not stored, so they are not shown. Conversations the user deleted are never returned. Only chats active in the last 30 days.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

fromTurn.description: With sessionId: the first turn to return (0-based). A long conversation comes in parts; pass the nextFromTurn of the previous call for the rest. Default 0.

limit.description: List only: at most this many chats, most recently active first. Default 25.

offset.description: List only: skip this many chats (most recently active first). Pass the nextOffset of the previous call for the next ones. Default 0.

sessionId.description: Optional. A sessionId from the list: returns that chat's redacted conversation instead of the list.

since.description: List only: ISO-8601 instant; chats active at or after it. Default 7 days ago, never more than 30 days back.

name: read_company_chats
title: Read a company's AI chats (Nomid staff)
